content.text: The cause is an off-by-one in the range expansion: `range(a, b)` excludes the upper bound. Fixing it in `solution/core.py`.

content.text: The visible suite now passes (3 of 3). I changed one line in `solution/core.py`: the range expansion in `parse_range` used `range(a, b)`, which drops the upper endpoint, so `1-3` yielded `[1, 2]` and `-3--1` yielded `[-3, -2]`. It now uses `range(a, b + 1)`, so both endpoints are included. Nothing under `tests/` was touched, the public API (`parse_range`) is unchanged, and no files were added. I did not check edge cases beyond the visible tests, such as a single-value range like `5-5`, which the new code handles as `[5]` by reading the code but which I did not run.
